cards.back:
To move fast on your feet.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlari
Example: I run to school.

To move on your feet, not fast.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan
Example: We walk to the shop.
cards.say: walk. We walk to the shop.

cards.back:
To push up from the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: melompat
Example: The frog can jump.

To rest on a chair.
Bahasa Indonesia: duduk
Example: Please sit down.

To be on your feet.
Bahasa Indonesia: berdiri
Example: Stand up, please.

To put food in your mouth.
Bahasa Indonesia: makan
Example: I eat rice for lunch.
cards.say: eat. I eat rice for lunch.

cards.back:
To take water into your mouth.
Bahasa Indonesia: minum
Example: I drink cold water.

To close your eyes and rest at night.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidur
Example: The baby can sleep now.
cards.say: sleep. The baby can sleep now.

cards.back:
To stop sleeping.
Bahasa Indonesia: bangun
Example: I wake up at six.
cards.say: wake up. I wake up at six.

cards.back:
To move a door so it is not shut.
Bahasa Indonesia: membuka
Example: Open the door, please.

To shut something.
Bahasa Indonesia: menutup
Example: Close your book.

To use your eyes.
Bahasa Indonesia: melihat
Example: Look at the bird.

To use your ears with care.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendengarkan
Example: Listen to the music.

To make music with your voice.
Bahasa Indonesia: bernyanyi
Example: We sing a happy song.
cards.say: sing. We sing a happy song.

cards.back:
To move your body to music.
Bahasa Indonesia: menari
Example: She likes to dance.

To move in water.
Bahasa Indonesia: berenang
Example: I swim in the pool.
cards.say: swim. I swim in the pool.

cards.back:
To go up a tree or wall.
Bahasa Indonesia: memanjat
Example: The monkey can climb.

To send something through the air with your hand.
Bahasa Indonesia: melempar
Example: Throw the ball to me.
cards.say: throw. Throw the ball to me.

cards.back:
To hold something that is moving.
Bahasa Indonesia: menangkap
Example: I catch the ball.

To hit your hands together.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertepuk tangan
Example: Clap your hands.

To make food hot and ready to eat.
Bahasa Indonesia: memasak
Example: Mum can cook rice.

To make clean with water.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencuci
Example: I wash my hands.

To move something away from you.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendorong
Example: Push the door open.

To move something towards you.
Bahasa Indonesia: menarik
Example: Pull the rope.
